title: Non-symmetric quantum interfaces with bilayer atomic arrays
summary: We study quantum light-matter interfaces based on bilayer atomic arrays in free space, considering interlayer spacings $a_z$ that may deviate from the Bragg-symmetric condition, $a_z\in \mathrm{integer}\times λ/2$ with $λ$ the light wavelength. Mapping the problem to a one-dimensional model, we show that the interface efficiency is fully determined by simple scattering observables $-$ reflection and transmission $-$ providing a direct, experimentally accessible characterization.
